notes: rust-stdlib-crypto over the reviewed hpke crate (rozbb/rust-hpke 0.14.1, MIT OR Apache-2.0) with p256/p384/p521/x25519-dalek, HKDF and the AES-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEADs. KEM, KDF, AEAD, PublicKey and PrivateKey are sealed traits over runtime-selected suites; Seal output is enc followed by the ciphertext, as in Go. The RFC 9180 test vectors of Go (rfc9180.json, 1000 encryptions and exports per suite) pass. The post-quantum KEMs and SHAKE KDFs are documented deviations.

DHKEM.note: only the RFC 9180 pairings (P-256/HKDF-SHA256, P-384/HKDF-SHA384, P-521/HKDF-SHA512, X25519/HKDF-SHA256) run; other pairings return a KEM whose operations report an error

MLKEM1024.note: the post-quantum and hybrid KEMs and the SHAKE KDFs of the HPKE post-quantum draft need the hpke crate's mlkem/shake features, which pull a second major version of sha3 (ADR 0003); the value exists and has the right ID but its operations return an error
